description: Land Acquisition - Kairathnagama, Maliela D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that specific parcels of land are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels (extents, boundaries, locations) but does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
